page.layout: One page of running text in one column; margin notes in the right margin (three notes); a catchword at the foot right and a signature at the foot left.

main_text.p: ficus Fridericus Blanchenhemius Blanchenhemius in locum Florentij suffectus episcopus, vir ambitiosissimi & inquietissimi ingenii, quamquam per literas solennes fidem civitati dedisset initio regiminis sui, omnia se ei jura ac privilegia conservaturum, pacta cum suis inita rata habiturum, patronum & protectorem ejus ubique ex æquo & bono futurum, aliaque facturum hujusmodi, rursumque à quadriennio peramicè cum eâ convenisset, cùm metus & periculum ab armis Hollandicis urgerent, tamen paulò post, periculo eo metuq; amoto, cùm videret reAnno Mccc. xcix,-centi bello externo pariter, ac sociali fessam civitatem, commodum id ratus cupidini suæ, callidissimo consilio novis eam armis domi implicuit. Anno McccciPrimùm enim pro exulibus, capitalibus civitatis inimicis, intercessorem se ingessit: mox non impetrata re, quasi supplicibus deesse non posset, simul aliis quoque causis, quas cupido suggerebat, prætextis, bellum movit. Eo moto, quod futurum prævidebat, canonis annui ex pacto Canonicis debiti solutio est impedita. Ita rescindendæ pa-ctionis color aliquis repertus. Inter caufas

page.notes: The leftmost opening letter is a fragment ("ficus"), probably the end of "Fridericus" continued from the previous page; read as printed with [?] not added because the scan is clear enough. The marginal date notes are printed with partial Roman numerals and may need checking: "Anno M ccc. xcix," and "Anno M cccc I". The line "Inter caufas" is followed by the catchword "alias". The text in the lower left, near the signature, is partly smudged. The scan shows show-through and a digitiser mark at the bottom right, which are left out.
